Meet the startups of our Venture Client Program 2026

Intro: insurers and startups work together.

The startups of the Venture Client Program 2026

Claimsy automates claims handling for property insurers. Riskbird, for example, predicts flood risk from satellite data. And go AVA builds conversational agents for brokers, while Allianz supports the programme.

Data & AI

Datalynx 2.0 extracts policy data from scanned documents. The Venture Client Program connects them.

ESG

Greenpolicy measures the carbon footprint of insurance portfolios.
